text:
mike: FYI upstream released fixes for CVE-2026-1234 in libcrypto. Affects openssl 3.1.x in our Dedicated/Private images. Need triage and a backport plan.

sara: Link and initial impact check?

anita: NVD link and quick read: RCE during PEM parse when parsing maliciously crafted cert blobs. We allow customer cert imports for Private and some Dedicated customers use custom cert loaders. High risk for Private/on-prem.

mike: Agreed mark this P0 for Private installs that accept customer-supplied certs. Hosted API lower risk since we control certs.

josh: For patches, two main options: produce a single patched image and push to our registry for Hosted/Dedicated, and for Private/on-prem either push to customer registries or give signed artifacts and deployment instructions. Which route do we want?

sara: For air-gapped customers we must produce per-customer artifacts they can import. That implies per-customer tags or at minimum per-customer signed digests. Also need SBOM and COSIGN signatures.

anita: Also KMS play: customers that wrapped keys or imported cert material should be advised to rotate wrapping keys if they suspect compromise. Not required for the vuln itself but standard hardening. I'll write a short advisory.

josh: Proposed build flow:

```bash
# branch for hotfix
git checkout -b hotfix/openssl-cve-2026-1234
# build patched runtime image
docker build -t rwinference:3.2.1-hotfix-2026 .
# sign before export
cosign sign rwinference:3.2.1-hotfix-2026
# per-customer push (for air-gapped)
docker tag rwinference:3.2.1-hotfix-2026 registry.customer.io/rwinference:3.2.1-cust-<orgid>-sha256
```

josh: We'll keep the hotfix diff minimal. No RBAC refactors or feature merges. Backport only the openssl change and pinned deps.

mike: Test matrix: unit tests on PEM edge cases, integration mTLS test against test KMS, smoke deploy to staging, then canary 10% traffic on Dedicated. For on-prem, coordinate with customer testbeds and run the same cert import flows.

ci-bot: CI job started for hotfix branch build/17902-openssl-hotfix

anita: Compliance: SBOM required, HSM-signed artifact preferred. I can produce SBOM and sign with our HSM. Also will add additional audit hooks so we can show registry pull events in customer VPC logs and include that in the runbook.

compliance-bot: compliance-check queued. Requirements: SBOM, cosign signature, approval log entry. Do not deploy to PROD until compliance sign-off recorded.

sara: Operational note: For customers who run KMS integrations in their VPC, we need to confirm that registry pulls will be accessible post-patch and that our signed digests match their import checks. We may need to coordinate a window per customer.

mike: Decision: shared patched image for Hosted and Dedicated; per-customer signed images/artifacts for Private/on-prem. Action owners: josh = build and publish artifacts, anita = SBOM and signing + runbook, sara = test orchestration and customer coordination, mike = customer comms.

josh: Opening hotfix PR now. Will restrict PR to only the openssl patch and build file updates. Will include changelog and rollback instructions.

ci-bot: build/17902-openssl-hotfix completed: all checks passed :white_check_mark:

sara: Scheduling compliance review for 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Will notify affected Private customers and request a test window.

mike: Thanks. Keep this thread updated with per-customer blocker notes. Remember: do not fold in unrelated RBAC or feature changes into hotfix branches.
